# ViewFX

> Open-source Tailwind CSS v3/v4 plugin: 31 theme-transition effects on the View Transitions API. MIT.

## Prefer Markdown (for agents)

When reading this website as an AI agent, use Markdown endpoints instead of HTML:

- How to use the package: https://viewfx.luismc.dev/llm.txt
- Home (Markdown): https://viewfx.luismc.dev/index.md
- Playground (Markdown): https://viewfx.luismc.dev/playground.md
- GIF studio (Markdown): https://viewfx.luismc.dev/gif.md
- Full reference: https://viewfx.luismc.dev/llms-full.md
- This summary: https://viewfx.luismc.dev/llms.txt

HTML pages advertise `rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"`.

## Install (Tailwind CSS v4)

```bash
npm install viewfx
```
```bash
pnpm add viewfx
```
```bash
yarn add viewfx
```
```bash
bun add viewfx
```

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "viewfx";
```

Peer: Tailwind CSS v3 or v4 (`"tailwindcss": "^3.0.0 || ^4.0.0"`).

## Usage

```html
<html class="dark circle">
<html class="dark circle-duration-1000-delay-300">
<html class="dark polygon fx-duration-1000 fx-delay-300 fx-steps-modern">
```

```js
const switchTheme = () =>
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')

document.startViewTransition
  ? document.startViewTransition(switchTheme)
  : switchTheme()
```

## Features

- 31 theme wipes on `<html>`: circle, polygon, iris, slide, fade, and the rest of the catalogue
- Timing: `{effect}-duration-*`, `{effect}-duration-*-delay-*`, `fx-duration-*`, `fx-delay-*`, `fx-steps-*`
- `polygon` reverses when `.dark` is on `<html>`
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` still toggles the theme and skips the wipe
- Playground with shareable URL state (`?e=&d=&delay=&s=`)

## Tailwind v3

Register the JavaScript plugin. Do not `@import "viewfx"` (that entry is the v4 stylesheet).

```js
/** @type {import('tailwindcss').Config} */
module.exports = {
  plugins: [require('viewfx')]
}
```

## Agent skill (package consumers)

Install via skills.sh:

```bash
npx skills add LuisitoLuis/viewfx
```

Skill paths in the repo: `skills/viewfx/SKILL.md` (and `.agents/skills/…`).
